summary: This note describes Gavar State University (GSU), a university located in Gavar, Gegharkunik Province, Armenia. It was founded on 5 May 1993 and is described as the largest university in Gegharkunik Province, with 4 faculties. The university offers degrees in Philology, Natural Sciences, Humanities and Economics, and more than 2,400 students are currently enrolled.
one_line: Gavar State University is a 1993-founded public university in Gavar, Gegharkunik Province, Armenia, with four faculties and over 2,400 students.
key_facts: Gavar State University (GSU) is a university in Gavar, Gegharkunik Province, Armenia.
Gavar State University was founded on 5 May 1993.
Gavar State University is the largest university in the Gegharkunik Province.
Gavar State University provides degrees in Philology.
Gavar State University provides degrees in Natural Sciences.
Gavar State University provides degrees in Humanities.
Gavar State University provides degrees in Economics.
More than 2,400 students are attending Gavar State University.
The Armenian name of Gavar State University is Գավառի Պետական Համալսարան.
